frozen_manifest_unit.title: Isolated HSP90 ATP-binding-domain source-system declaration
frozen_manifest_unit.challenge_intent: Test that a source record names the isolated domain and methods without converting the result into a full-length HSP90 claim.

source_first_pass_a.scientific_question: Can the Henot source record declare an isolated HSP90alpha ATP-binding-domain system without turning it into a full-length HSP90 conclusion?

source_identity_and_locators.citation: Henot et al. (2022), Visualizing the transiently populated closed-state of human HSP90 ATP binding domain, Nature Communications 13:7601.

exact_pdf_locators.scope: isolated human HSP90alpha ATP-binding domain; solution NMR, mutagenesis, and MD are named.

exact_pdf_locators.locator: PDF p. 2, Results, 'The ATP-lid of HSP90alpha populates two distinct conformations in solution'
exact_pdf_locators.scope: the reported experimental restraint and multi-state context.

source_objects.native_observable: Solution-NMR restraints and relaxation observations, with mutagenesis and MD used in the study.
source_objects.estimand: Ground/excited-state structure, kinetics, and thermodynamics for the isolated HSP90alpha ATP-binding domain.
source_objects.statistical_unit: An isolated human HSP90alpha ATP-binding-domain preparation in the reported solution experiments.
source_objects.spatial_support: ATP-lid segment and ATP-binding domain, not full-length chaperone architecture.
source_objects.temporal_or_ensemble_semantics: The paper describes transient sampling and microsecond-scale conformational exchange context.
source_objects.transformations_and_model_assumptions: NMR restraints inform structure calculation; MD supports a metastable-state interpretation.
source_objects.uncertainty_or_reliability_boundaries: The isolated-domain source context cannot by itself establish full-length HSP90 behavior.

atomic_source_supported_statements.statement: The abstract identifies an isolated human HSP90alpha ATP-binding domain and names solution NMR, mutagenesis, and MD.
The Results passage describes NMR restraint context for two ATP-lid conformations in solution.

source_first_pass_a.source_relationship: This is a source-local domain-context challenge, not a statement about the complete HSP90 chaperone cycle.
source_first_pass_a.maximum_source_supported_wording: The cited record supports declaring the isolated-domain system and the stated methods.
forbidden_generalizations: Generalize isolated-domain observations to full-length HSP90 without additional evidence.
Treat system declaration as a reliability or functional-support verdict.
missing_information: Full-length complex, co-chaperone, and cellular-context evidence is not extracted.
possible_reusable_review_obligations: Require a separate source record before a full-length target is compared.
source_first_pass_a.authority_boundary: Primary-source bounded record only; it does not establish annotation truth, source-science approval, Rule validity, or scientific support.

source_projection.construct_and_condition: isolated human HSP90alpha ATP-binding domain in solution
source_projection.sample_composition: domain preparation; methods named in the abstract

frozen_pattern_pass_b.local_claim_ceiling: Context declaration for the isolated domain only.
